capabilities: Cycle through tabs in recently used order with a held modifier key
Navigate tabs left to right across the whole window
Assign custom hotkeys instead of fixed defaults
Combine with Vim keybindings for mouse-free control
extras: The plugin sets no default hotkeys; users must assign them themselves. Renamed from "Cycle Through Panes".
intentEvidence: In contrast to the native Obsidian commands, they ignore panes/tab groups and work per window.
problem: Obsidian's built-in tab navigation commands are limited to pane and tab groups, so keyboard users cannot cycle across all tabs of a window in usage order.

relations.evidence: In Combination with Mr. Jackphils Jump to Link plugin and Vim Keybindings

summary: Tab navigation plugin that switches between tabs with Ctrl+Tab in recently used order or left-to-right order, like a browser.
